changelog: Aura AI v2.0.8 Permanent Clean Chat UI, Modern Attachment Sheet & Model Picker
Permanent Aura Chat UI: Single seamless screen for all conversations, eliminating legacy header/footer and jump-back bugs
Clean Conversation View: Right-aligned user bubbles (max 80% width, 20dp corners), clean full-width markdown assistant replies
Restyled Generating & Error States: Playful decoded verb status animation and soft-elevated white Retry button on failure
Inline Actions: Long-press context menu on assistant messages with instant 'Copy' and 'Regenerate'
Floating Input Pill: Dynamic action button (Stop button during streaming, Send arrow when typed, Voice note / mic when idle) with 56dp image thumbnail & file chip previews
Redesigned Add-to-Chat Sheet: 3 equal top cards (Photo / Image, Document / File, From Files) with integrated Model Picker & Thinking Preference control
